title: THE ITEM WHEEL ON A CONTROLLER
why: His order of 2026-10-14, for the controller: hold D-DOWN to open the item wheel, push the right stick toward a segment and let go of D-DOWN to take the item out; RT then uses it, as the mouse button does. LB and RB still walk the guns, and the crosshair stays still while the wheel is open. D-DOWN no longer heals in the arcade; the wheel is the only way to a heal. While you are down, D-DOWN still revives you as before. Releasing with the stick in the middle cancels.
now: On a controller, hold D-DOWN and push the right stick to open and use the item wheel.
